item.title: Small Kitchen Organization Ideas: A Practical Small-Space Guide
item.description: Measure Before You Shop Most kitchen organizers fail for one reason: they were bought before anyone measured. A few numbers decide what will fit, and most of them are standard enough to check against your own kitchen: Base cabinets are usually about 24 inches deep, while wall cabinets are usually about 12 inches deep. A shelf organizer sized for one will not suit the other. The gap between the counter and the bottom of the wall cabinets is commonly around 18 inches.
